summary: Tested Pitcher H2H feature (backend + frontend). Backend endpoint /api/picks/{id}/pitcher-h2h returns 200 with correct shape for MLB strikeout picks, opp_team correctly resolves (KC pitcher -> 'St. Louis Cardinals', NOT 'Kansas City Royals'). Auth gate works (401 unauth). 404 returned for non-strikeout / missing picks. resolve_opp_team_name helper verified with KC@STL and TEX vs SD cases. /api/version returns data_version='2026.06.22-pitcher-h2h-ui'. Frontend PitcherH2HPanel renders on MLB strikeout pick (Noah Cameron 2.5 K) with bento grid (H2H K AVG 5.0 / SEASON K AVG 5.0), 'ON PAR vs OPP' trend pill, and 2 recent starts vs STL (JUN 18: 6K / MAY 16: 4K). Panel correctly hidden on soccer pick. All 8 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend integration verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: mlb_pitcher_h2h.py: season is hardcoded to 2026 in fetch_pitcher_h2h (line 136). Acceptable while in season, but consider deriving from datetime.utcnow().year for forward-compat.

Endpoint returns 200 with ok=false for pitcher_not_found / no_game_log cases. Panel correctly hides via `data.ok === false`. Consider returning 404 in this case so frontend can treat consistently with other failure modes — currently OK but worth noting.
MLB_ABBREV_TO_NAME map is comprehensive (covers KCR/KC, SDP/SD, etc.). Fallback city-token match (line 63-70) is a nice safety net.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed pick 48600ae0-0268-5e82-99f2-8aab24d563cd (Noah Cameron KC O2.5 K vs STL) and soccer pick 462da494 for negative case.
